mine_news.headline: Caleb Wilson: Nets 21 points with full line in win
mine_news.body: Wilson produced 21 points (7-14 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 5-6 FT), six rebounds, one assist, one steal, two blocks and three turnovers across 33 minutes in Friday's 132-125 win over the Bucks.

mine_news.headline: Dyson Daniels grabs seven steals in dominant performance vs. Hornets
mine_news.body: Dyson Daniels lived up to his billing as the "Great Barrier Thief'' as he and masked warrior Jock Landale helped the Atlanta Hawks extend their winning start to the NBA season.

mine_news.headline: Amen Thompson stuffs Wemby's last-second shot as Rockets hold off Spurs
mine_news.body: Rockets guard Amen Thompson blocked Victor Wembanyama at the rim to prevent a potential tying bucket as the Rockets beat the Spurs 114-110.
